description: This file defines the ResourcesDatasource class, which manages resource data fetching, selection, and state management for an Angular application, specifically for resource information in the Thingsboard platform.

classes.name: ResourcesDatasource
classes.description: A data source class for managing resource information, including loading, selection, and pagination.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Connects the data source to a collection viewer, returning an observable of resource entities.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects the data source, completing internal subjects.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the data source to an empty state.

methods.name: loadEntities
methods.description: Loads resource entities based on pagination, resource type, and subtype, updating internal state.

methods.name: fetchEntities
methods.description: Fetches resource data from the ResourceService.

methods.name: isAllSelected
methods.description: Returns an observable indicating whether all entities are selected.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Returns an observable indicating whether the entity list is empty.

methods.name: total
methods.description: Returns an observable of total number of resource entities.

methods.name: masterToggle
methods.description: Toggles selection of all entities based on current selection state.
